problem.name: Sampling commuting quantum circuits
problem.statement_latex: Given a circuit $U$ of $g$ gates diagonal in the Pauli-$X$ basis, sample $x$ with probability $|\langle x|U|0^n\rangle|^2$. Standard IQP families use a fixed finite gate set; approximation error is total variation distance. Complexity uses gates and classical sampling time.
problem.statement_text: Given a circuit $U$ of $g$ gates diagonal in the Pauli-$X$ basis, sample $x$ with probability $|\langle x|U|0^n\rangle|^2$. Standard IQP families use a fixed finite gate set; approximation error is total variation distance. Complexity uses gates and classical sampling time.

strength.description_latex: Polynomial quantum sampling versus the best applicable exponential or subexponential classical simulator.
strength.description_text: Polynomial quantum sampling versus the best applicable exponential or subexponential classical simulator.

evidence.description_latex: Polynomial classical sampling within $1/192$ in $\ell_1$ distance gives a third-level polynomial-hierarchy collapse under either average-case conjecture in Bremner--Montanaro--Shepherd.
evidence.description_text: Polynomial classical sampling within $1/192$ in $\ell_1$ distance gives a third-level polynomial-hierarchy collapse under either average-case conjecture in Bremner–Montanaro–Shepherd.

hardware.description_latex: $n$ qubits and $g$ commuting gates; non-Clifford operations and approximation accuracy determine implementation demands.
hardware.description_text: $n$ qubits and $g$ commuting gates; non-Clifford operations and approximation accuracy determine implementation demands.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(g+n)$ gates and measurements. Equivalently, apply Hadamards, commuting diagonal phase gates, Hadamards, then computational-basis measurement.
quantum.headline_text: $O(g+n)$ gates and measurements. Equivalently, apply Hadamards, commuting diagonal phase gates, Hadamards, then computational-basis measurement.

classical.headline_latex: Take the best of $O(g2^n)$ state-vector simulation, $\operatorname{poly}(g)2^{O(w)}$ contraction at width $w$, and $\operatorname{poly}(s)2^{O(s/\sqrt{\log s})}$ sparse-Boolean-encoding path counting for finite-algebraic-gate marginals. Clifford-only circuits admit polynomial stabilizer simulation.
